description: This file contains database query functions related to card management, including fetching active cards, counting used cards, and managing card limit timestamps within the Mattermost Focalboard project.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer for Focalboard, with methods for managing card data.

methods.name: activeCardsQuery
methods.description: Builds a query to fetch active cards with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: getUsedCardsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active cards in the system.

methods.name: getCardLimitTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last card limit update from system settings.

methods.name: updateCardLimitTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last card limit update in system settings.
